'''Madame Atuarre's Roving Performers''' was a fictitious name used by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Atuarre]], [[Pakka]], and [[BLX-5]] as they professed to be a troupe of entertainers from the [[Imperial Entertainers' Guild]] in order to infiltrate the [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] [[Prison/Legends|prison facility]]. Solo created this group as a replacement act&mdash;after intercepting an apology for being delayed from [[Hokkor Long]] to [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]] [[Mirkovig Hirken|Hirken]]. Solo adopted the persona of [[Han Solo/Legends|Master Marksman]] during the ruse. Atuarre was to perform the [[Trianii ritual dance]] while her son was to execute acrobatic feats. They had planned, originally, for Bollux to be a storyteller, but when the group discovered that Hirken owned a [[Mark X Executioner droid/Legends|Mark X Executioner]]-series gladiatorial droid and was awaiting an opponent for it, Solo quickly created the guise of [[Annihilator (alias)|Annihilator]] for the [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]].
